# Psalm 16 — Disagreement Log

## 16:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Therefore my-heart is-glad and-my-glory [tongue] rejoices; also my-flesh dwells in-safety.
- **LOGOS:** Therefore my heart is glad, and my whole being rejoices; my flesh also dwells secure.
- **PNEUMA:** No wonder my heart is glad and I rejoice! My body rests in safety.
